spotify_pitch: Cold, relentless, menacing. The Deceiver is a four on the floor EBM track for the last hours of a dark room. A driving bassline and raw, cold synths carry it, an acid line threading the background, 126 BPM. Written around betrayal, it holds its tension and never lets up. Produced in Berlin, it belongs in late night EBM, industrial and dark techno sets. The second of two, following Farewell.
spotify_artist_pick: The Deceiver is out. Dark, relentless EBM for the late hours. The second of two, following Farewell.
